localConfig.reason: react-app/.env is tracked, and Vite reads it into every build — a local host written here reaches everyone who pulls. The API base and the Keycloak URL both fall back to a localhost default in code, so pointing them at a local server is the routine change that must not land in the tracked file; react-app/.gitignore already ignores *.local, which is what makes .env.local the per-machine half

forbidden.reason: react-app declares no test script, so this exits 0 having run nothing — the CI job's own `npm run test --if-present` does the same. A green exit here is not a passing suite and must never be reported as one
